resolved_summary: Instrument and session are unambiguous: XAUUSD, London session.
The directional bias rule is measurable and maps onto HERMES structure fields.

unresolved_items.why_unresolved: Large is not quantified. Wick size could be an absolute price distance, a fraction of the candle range, or a multiple of recent average wick length, and the three disagree on real bars.

resolution_needed.description: Choose the measure and the threshold: wick length as a fraction of candle range, with a minimum ratio.

candidate_definitions.label: Fraction of candle range
candidate_definitions.measurable_definition: Wick length divided by total candle range is at least a parameterised ratio.

required_hermes_fields.purpose: Upper wick length of the evaluated bar.
High minus low of the evaluated bar.

candidate_definitions.label: Multiple of recent average wick
candidate_definitions.measurable_definition: Wick length is at least N times the mean wick length over a parameterised lookback.

unresolved_items.why_unresolved: Neither the resistance level construction nor the proximity tolerance is stated, so proximity cannot be evaluated mechanically.

resolution_needed.description: Decide how resistance is constructed and the tolerance band that counts as near.

unresolved_items.why_unresolved: No timezone is given, and HSA records UTC only. Morning is not resolvable without one.

resolution_needed.description: Establish from run evidence whether a session filter changes the outcome before adopting one.
